svg.metadata: {"story":"Ruth","act":1,"chapter":"Ch.1 · Leaving Moab","scene":"A","layer":"foreground","artDirection":"Naomi, with her daughters-in-law, leaves Moab for Bethlehem, and Orpah turns back; Ruth clings to Naomi and to her people.
